assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with arrhythmic activity and optimize rate control management
The diagnostic service addresses the clinical need identified in the indication note
